summary: 5 TCs reviewed; 1 real LOW-severity defect: hardcoded start_date='2026-04-20' in sync_url will return ever-growing windows as time passes. Should be a relative window (e.g., last 7 days). Defensive [{}] fallback for empty data verified.

defects.description: sync_url has HARDCODED start_date='2026-04-20'. As of audit date (2026-04-28) this returns ~8 days of readiness, but the window grows unbounded over time. Will eventually return months/years of data, slowing sync and bloating integration.config.
defects.expected: Rolling window — e.g., start_date computed as (today - 7 days).isoformat()

defects.description: Defensive but unusual: `(body or {}).get('data', []) or [{}]` — works but inscrutable.
defects.actual: Empty list correctly falls back to [{}], and {}.get('score')=None — no crash. Verified.

notes: DEF-100-01 is a real defect but LOW severity. Will be aggregated and fixed in a single audit-fixup commit at the end of the campaign rather than per-batch.
DEF-100-02 is style, not a defect — included as observation.
